section_summary.extract_value: This section describes preliminary data analyses conducted prior to path analytic modeling. The authors handled twelve missing data points by substituting participants' mean scale or subscale scores, and examined variables for normality of distribution using skewness and kurtosis criteria (absolute skewness > 3 and kurtosis > 10). All variables met normality assumptions (skewness range = -1.21 to 1.69, kurtosis range = -0.58 to 3.55), so no transformations were applied. Variable means, standard deviations, and bivariate correlations are referenced as being presented in Table 1.
